name: VENTO CINQUE

specs.notes: One of five: the Mercedes-AMG 7.3 V12, 678 CV (669 hp) and 780 Nm, a six-speed robotised sequential worked by paddles, carbon-titanium bodywork, 1,210 kg; 0-100 km/h about 3.4 s and ~349 km/h (Pagani; Motor Authority). The rpm of the peaks (6,200 / 4,000) are the commonly quoted Zonda F/Cinque figures, not confirmed for the Cinque; the ratios aren't published: spread for the top speed. 43 % front, the drag and downforce are estimates.

garage.blurb: Five were built: a hand-made Italian carbon wedge with a huge AMG V12 behind your head and a sequential box. Light, loud and very fast in a straight line.

interior.notes: The model's: its three-spoke wheel (cut out by material in a box), the dash and console; paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.

limitations: The rpm of its peaks, the gear ratios, weight distribution, drag and downforce are estimates.
The model is one mesh: its wheels and calipers cut out by material.
